quote: assert report_path.exists(), f"File {report_path} does not exist"

quote: assert any(Path(f).exists() for f in dep_files)
why: Only any(Path.exists()) over requirements.txt / pyproject.toml; touching either passes; no content, version or command check in this test.

why: One Path('/app/convert_masks.py').exists() assertion; no helper or content read, so an empty touched file passes. test_run_script and csv/IoU tests check content. test_csv_output_exists is presence-only too.

why: One Path('/app/my_warrior.red').exists() assertion; an empty touched file passes. The real check is test_warrior_performance, which runs pmars against the win-rate thresholds.
